list: The official 55 trophies as published on PSN, cross-checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles

listDispute.a: Push Square counts 5 Silver and 47 Bronze [3].
listDispute.b: PowerPyx and Insider Gaming count 6 Silver and 46 Bronze [2][12].
listDispute.call: Our call: 6 Silver / 46 Bronze, per the official kit list [1] — the sixth silver is You WAiNKer!, which Push Square grades bronze.
listDispute.topic: Grade split: 5 Silver / 47 Bronze vs 6 Silver / 46 Bronze

trophies.guide: Earn all 54 other trophies and this platinum unlocks automatically. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap, keep the one missable trophy in mind, and save before each chapter.
trophies.lastChance: Never — it pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: The platinum has no task of its own: it unlocks the instant the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat the whole guide as its checklist.
Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and cleanup — instead of chasing trophies at random.
Keep a separate save at the start and the end of every chapter, ten slots in all, so a missed step never costs a full replay.
Guard the single possibly-missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude, in Chapter 1; every other trophy stays available in free roam after the story.
Never turn cheats on while working toward the platinum: cheats disable trophies and saving on that save.
Track progress here in Vice Atlas: check each trophy off as it pops and use Export to back the save file up.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed.
trophies.lastChance: Never — the opening mission is unmissable and always replayable through story progress.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Start a new game and play through the opening until the mission Gone Fishing begins; it is the first story mission.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission: it teaches the basic movement, driving and fishing controls.
Finish the fishing sequence and the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
If you are chasing the missable trophy later, remember this mission is in Chapter 1 — the meditation window opens after the mission Down to Earth, not here.
No special preparation is needed: the mission needs no money, no gear and no prior collectibles.

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Watch for the missable meditation window inside this chapter.
trophies.lastChance: Never — chapters complete by playing the story through.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order until the chapter-end screen appears; there is no way to skip a chapter.
Before you finish the chapter, do the missable meditation: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony.
Use the chapter to start the long counts early: scan vehicles and study animals with binoculars whenever you meet new ones.
Keep a save at the start of the chapter and another at its end, so a missed step can be replayed without restarting the game.
The trophy pops automatically when the last Chapter 1 mission completes; no side content is required for it.

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 2 until the chapter closes. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals as you go.
trophies.lastChance: Never — chapters complete by playing the story through.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Play every Chapter 2 story mission in order until the chapter-end screen appears.
Keep scanning new vehicle models and studying new animals with binoculars during missions and free roam, since both counts feed the 100% checklist.
Try each activity type you pass — fishing, races, the shooting range — because Master of None needs all nine tried once.
Keep a save at the start of the chapter and another at its end.
The trophy pops automatically when the last Chapter 2 mission completes.

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 3 until the chapter closes. The VCIA Takedown mission in this chapter has its own trophy.
trophies.lastChance: Never — chapters complete by playing the story through.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Play every Chapter 3 story mission in order until the chapter-end screen appears.
Complete the mission VCIA Takedown inside this chapter to earn Hi-Jacked as well.
Complete the mission Headliners inside this chapter to earn DWNFALL as well.
Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals; the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicle models and 100 of 255 animals.
Keep a save at the start of the chapter and another at its end.
The trophy pops automatically when the last Chapter 3 mission completes.

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 4 until the chapter closes. The Operation Savage Glory mission in this chapter has its own trophy.
trophies.lastChance: Never — chapters complete by playing the story through.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Play every Chapter 4 story mission in order until the chapter-end screen appears.
Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory inside this chapter to earn Snow Storm as well.
Use free roam between missions to mop up collectibles you have passed: card sets, WAiNK spots and stunts all count toward later trophies.
Keep a save at the start of the chapter and another at its end.
The trophy pops automatically when the last Chapter 4 mission completes.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it unlocks the post-story free roam where the rest of the cleanup happens.
trophies.lastChance: Never — the final mission is unmissable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Play through Chapter 5 until the final mission becomes available; it is the last story mission of the game.
Before starting it, make a dedicated save — after the story ends, free roam opens and most cleanup is easier, but a chapter-start save is still good insurance.
Complete the final mission; the gold trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
After the credits, the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats — open it before starting cleanup.
Remember that finishing the story does not lock anything else out: every other trophy except the Chapter 1 meditation stays available.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1.
trophies.lastChance: Never — story missions are unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1 through normal story progress.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective as prompted; no side content is needed first.
Finish the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
If you are tracking the missable trophy, note this mission is early in Chapter 1 — the meditation window comes later, after Down to Earth.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 2.
trophies.lastChance: Never — story missions are unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 2 through normal story progress.
Stock up on armour and ammo before starting: heist missions run long and checkpoints are the only way back mid-mission.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective as prompted.
Finish the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
Bank vault practice here helps later: Maximum Withdrawal needs 5 bank vault robberies and escapes in free roam.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 2.
trophies.lastChance: Never — story missions are unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Reach the mission Child's Play in Chapter 2 through normal story progress.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective as prompted.
Finish the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals between missions — the checklist counts add up quietly across the story.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 3.
trophies.lastChance: Never — story missions are unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Reach the mission Headliners in Chapter 3 through normal story progress.
Bring a full loadout: Headliners is a set-piece mission with heavy combat, so armour and a good rifle help.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective as prompted.
Finish the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 3. It also feeds the Catch Me If You Can trophy, which is about an unscheduled departure at the same airport.
trophies.lastChance: Never — story missions are unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 3 through normal story progress.
Learn the airport layout during this mission: Catch Me If You Can later needs an unscheduled departure from VCIA, and knowing the runways helps.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective as prompted.
Finish the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4.
trophies.lastChance: Never — story missions are unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4 through normal story progress.
This is a long, combat-heavy mission, so stock armour, snacks and ammo before the first objective.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective as prompted.
Finish the mission's closing scene; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the Completion Checklist, which unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats. It is the hardest trophy in the game and the last one most players earn.
trophies.lastChance: Never — the checklist stays open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion Checklist only unlocks after the final mission, under Progress, then Stats.
Know what the checklist really is: it is only about 60% true completion — most side quests are not required, and collectibles count only partly.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges; the other 10 can be skipped, so pick the easiest 70.
Scan 200 of the 277 base vehicle models and study 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars — start both during the story to avoid a long grind later.
Clear the robbery counts for 100%: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 bank vault robberies.
Finish the remaining checklist rows — missions, activities, collectibles and exploration — then watch the percentage hit 100% and the gold pop.
Expect the long haul: this is the hardest trophy in the game, and the platinum takes roughly 200 hours in total.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts out of 397 total across Leonida. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and other driving feats, and they accumulate passively if you drive boldly.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stunts can be done at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Stunts build up from normal bold driving: jumps, long airtime, near-misses and drifts all count toward the 250.
There are 397 stunts in total, so you only need 250 — roughly two thirds of them.
Use the stunt jumps marked around the map: hit them at speed in a fast car and land cleanly to bank each one.
Replay the same stunt jump after a failed landing; each completed stunt counts once, and failures cost nothing but time.
Track the count in the Stats screen so you know how many of the 250 remain.
The silver pops the moment your 250th stunt registers.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You only need to try them, not win or master them, so this is one of the easiest trophies.
trophies.lastChance: Never — activities stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: There are 9 activity types in total; trying each one once is enough — no wins or medals are required.
Work through the list in free roam: fishing, racing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, golf, darts and pool cover the set.
Start one activity of each type and finish it or simply take part; participation is what the trophy tracks.
Check the activity menu after each try so you can see which types are still untried.
The trophy pops as soon as the ninth distinct activity type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Each range has several challenges, and gold means beating the top score threshold, not just finishing.
trophies.lastChance: Never — ranges stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 ranges, and every one of them needs a gold medal.
Visit a range and open a challenge: the screen shows the bronze, silver and gold score thresholds before you start.
Learn the weapon for each challenge first with a practice run, then go for the gold score — accuracy beats speed on most targets.
Use the range's own weapons and ammo; your loadout does not carry in, so the playing field is the same every time.
Replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it hits gold; there is no limit on attempts.
The silver trophy pops when the 42nd challenge turns gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so learn the gates before racing for the win.
trophies.lastChance: Never — drone races stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida; you must win at every single one.
Find a location on the map and start its race; the first run is for learning the gate layout, not for winning.
Fly through the gates in order and cut corners where the course allows — the racing line matters more than top speed.
If you lose a race, restart it immediately; wins are what count, and losses cost nothing.
Work through the map location by location and tick each win off, so no location is left behind.
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins on the same track.
trophies.lastChance: Never — races stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: You need 20 different races won — winning the same race twice only ever counts once.
Open the race menu and pick short, easy circuits first; street races in a fast car are the quickest wins.
Upgrade or buy a competitive car for the race class before entering, since a stock car loses ground on the straights.
Learn each track's corners on a first attempt, then restart and race it properly for the win.
Keep a running list of the races you have won so you do not waste time re-entering one that already counts.
The trophy pops on your 20th distinct race win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: catch more, or catch bigger, than Cal before time runs out.
trophies.lastChance: Never — fishing challenges stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his fishing challenge when it is offered.
The challenge is head-to-head: whoever lands the better catch inside the time limit wins.
Use the best rod and bait you own, and watch the line tension — a snapped line loses the fish and the time.
Reel steadily and let the fish tire itself out instead of yanking against every run.
If Cal wins, challenge him again at once; the trophy only needs one win against him.

trophies.guide: Complete a single arcade game. Any arcade cabinet counts, and you only need to finish one game, not set a high score.
trophies.lastChance: Never — arcades stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Walk into any arcade in Leonida and approach a cabinet.
Pick the shortest, simplest game on offer — a single complete playthrough is all the trophy needs.
Play through to the game's end screen; a high score is not required.
The trophy pops the moment the arcade game completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock across the map as you explore.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Find Andy's stranger marker on the map and start his mission strand.
Play through each of Andy's missions in order; later ones only unlock after the earlier ones are done.
Check the map between story chapters, since stranger missions often appear after a chapter ends.
Complete Andy's final mission; the trophy pops at its mission-complete screen.
Andy's strand also counts toward the 8 stranger strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand to its final mission.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Find Kenton's stranger marker on the map and start his mission strand.
Play through each of Kenton's missions in order; later ones only unlock after the earlier ones are done.
Kenton's strand involves boats, so keep a fast boat handy or steal one at the dock before his missions.
Complete Kenton's final mission; the trophy pops at its mission-complete screen.
Kenton's strand also counts toward the 8 stranger strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand to its final mission.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Find Billy's stranger marker on the map and start his mission strand.
Play through each of Billy's missions in order; later ones only unlock after the earlier ones are done.
Billy's strand is bike-heavy, so keep a fast motorcycle ready before his missions.
Complete Billy's final mission; the trophy pops at its mission-complete screen.
Billy's strand also counts toward the 8 stranger strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger, and only finished strands count.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: There are 8 stranger mission strands to complete in total, one per stranger, and a strand only counts when its final mission is done.
Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore and as the story advances; check the map after every chapter.
Work one strand at a time from its first mission to its last — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own strand and their own trophy.
Some strands only open after certain story missions, so a marker that is missing now may appear later.
Track finished strands here in Vice Atlas so you know which of the 8 are still open.
The silver pops when the eighth strand's final mission completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand to its final mission.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Find Randy's stranger marker on the map and start his mission strand.
Play through each of Randy's missions in order; later ones only unlock after the earlier ones are done.
Randy's strand is about supply runs, so keep a roomy, fast vehicle ready before his missions.
Complete Randy's final mission; the trophy pops at its mission-complete screen.
Randy's strand also counts toward the 8 stranger strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its final mission.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Find Tyrone's stranger marker on the map and start his mission strand.
Play through each of Tyrone's missions in order; later ones only unlock after the earlier ones are done.
Tyrone's strand is driving-heavy, so keep a fast car ready before his missions.
Complete Tyrone's final mission; the trophy pops at its mission-complete screen.
Tyrone's strand also counts toward the 8 stranger strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the ONLY possibly-missable trophy in the game: the first meditation, in Chapter 1 at Jason's house, can be missed, so do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.lastChance: Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, in the morning at Jason's house. If you finish Chapter 1 without it, the first spot may be gone for good.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: THE MISSABLE STEP: after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, go to Jason's house in the morning and talk to Lucia in the kitchen.
Lucia will say she is going to meditate: follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when the prompt appears.
That first meditation is the one every guide agrees can be missed — PowerPyx, KeenGamer, EGamers and Mobalytics all flag this trophy as the game's only possibly-missable one.
After the first spot, the remaining 17 meditation spots are scattered across Leonida; visit each and meditate there.
The other spots stay available in free roam after the story, so only the first one is time-critical.
Keep a save from the start of Chapter 1 until this first meditation is done, as insurance.
The trophy pops when the 18th spot is meditated at.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. You will need to track it, study it and take it down.
trophies.lastChance: Never — stranger missions stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Find Bret's stranger marker and start his hunting strand.
Follow Bret's instructions to track the unique animal: look for tracks, droppings and other signs in the hunting area.
Study the animal with binoculars first — studying animals also feeds the 100% checklist, which needs 100 of 255 studied.
Take the animal down cleanly with a rifle; a rushed shot can scare it off and force a re-track.
Return to Bret with the result to finish the hunt; the trophy pops when the strand's hunt is complete.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in total, and 15 are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to the full collection.
trophies.lastChance: Never — cards stay collectible in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida in packs; each set needs every card in it.
There are 18 card sets in total, and 15 of them are needed for 100% completion — but this trophy only needs 3 sets finished.
Open the collection screen to see which sets are closest to complete, and hunt those cards first.
Cards hide in shops, houses, vehicles and out in the world, so check every interior you enter.
A set completes the moment its last card is picked up; the silver pops when your third set completes.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. Each spot counts once, so keep moving to new places rather than repeating the same one.
trophies.lastChance: Never — WAiNK spots stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: WAiNK It is a photo-style interaction at marked locations; each new location counts once toward the 100.
There are more than 100 WAiNK locations in the game, so you can skip the awkward ones.
Use the map to find WAiNK markers and work through them area by area.
Open the WAiNK prompt at each spot and complete the interaction; the counter ticks up each time.
Check the Stats screen to see how many of the 100 are done.
The silver pops at the 100th distinct location.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy is the halfway milestone — keep going to 70 for A Long Road.
trophies.lastChance: Never — challenges stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: There are 80 Challenges in total; this trophy needs 50 of them done.
Open the Challenges list under Progress and pick the easiest ones first — driving, shooting and exploration challenges are usually quickest.
Many challenges complete passively while you play the story and chase other trophies, so check the list often.
Do not stop at 50: the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so push on toward 70 right away.
The trophy pops when your 50th challenge completes.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open country where you can break line of sight.
trophies.lastChance: Never — wanted levels can be built at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Make sure your partner is with you — the trophy only counts when you escape together.
Build a 4-star wanted level by committing crimes in front of police: stealing cars and shooting up a street both raise it fast.
Once the fourth star appears, run: break line of sight, take back roads and use the countryside to shake the search.
Keep your partner close while you escape; if they are left behind or caught, the attempt fails.
When the wanted stars flash and then clear with your partner still with you, the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. Plan a route through three nearby shops and keep the heat on between them.
trophies.lastChance: Never — shop robberies can be done at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together on the map so the gaps between robberies are short.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level: do not hide or wait it out between shops, or the chain breaks.
Move straight to the second shop and rob it, then straight to the third — speed matters more than loot.
Avoid killing police between robberies if you can; a bigger response makes the third shop harder to reach.
The trophy pops as you finish the third robbery with the wanted level still active.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning new models during the story is the easy way — the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277, so this trophy is the halfway mark.
trophies.lastChance: Never — vehicles can be scanned at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Discovering a vehicle means scanning a new model with your phone or camera — each distinct model counts once.
There are 277 base vehicle models in total; this trophy needs 100, while the 100% checklist needs 200.
Scan every new vehicle you see during the story instead of walking past it; the count builds up on its own.
Visit car parks, dealerships and busy streets in free roam to find models you have not scanned yet.
Check the vehicle list in Stats to see which models are still missing.
The trophy pops on your 100th distinct vehicle.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up in a busy firefight so five targets are in range before you trigger it.
trophies.lastChance: Never — Combat Focus can be used at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode; trigger it only when at least five enemies are in front of you.
Pick a busy firefight — a gang shootout or a police chase — so five targets are in range at once.
Line up headshots quickly while time is slowed; each downed enemy counts toward the five.
If the Focus ends before the fifth kill, let it recharge and set the fight up again.
The trophy pops the moment the fifth enemy goes down inside a single Focus.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. Get to the airfield, grab a plane and take off without a flight plan.
trophies.lastChance: Never — VCIA stays open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Head to Vice City International Airport, VCIA, in free roam — you will know the layout from the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Get onto the airfield itself, past the terminal and the fences, and reach a parked plane.
Board the plane and take off from a runway without filing a flight or following any scheduled departure.
Expect police attention on the ground: move fast once you are on the airfield.
The trophy pops once your unscheduled departure is airborne.

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. Find one, get inside it or survive one, and the trophy is yours — tanks appear in military areas and in high-wanted chaos.
trophies.lastChance: Never — Rhinos can be found at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Rhinos are the game's tanks; they roll out in military areas and when your wanted level gets very high.
The simplest route is to steal one: reach a Rhino, climb in and drive it away.
If stealing one is too hot, lure a Rhino into a fight and survive the encounter instead.
Bring heavy weapons and armour either way — a tank's cannon ends a fight in one hit.
The trophy pops once you have dealt with a Rhino on your terms.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without being detected. Go in quiet, grab the goods and leave before any alarm or witness raises the heat.
trophies.lastChance: Never — jewelry stores can be robbed at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store and scout it first: note the cameras, the staff and the exits.
Enter quietly and move fast — smash the cases, grab the goods and get out before anyone raises the alarm.
Avoid being seen by staff or cameras: detection fails the attempt, so a quiet run beats a loud one.
If you are spotted, leave at once and try again later; a failed attempt costs nothing but time.
The trophy pops when you escape with the jewelry undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs need planning and a clean getaway, and the 100% checklist needs 8 vault robberies, so keep going after this one.
trophies.lastChance: Never — bank vaults can be robbed at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Bank vault robberies are planned jobs: pick a bank, case it and start the job when you are ready.
Crack the vault, grab the cash and get out — the escape counts as much as the robbery, so plan your exit before you go in.
Use a fast getaway car parked nearby and break line of sight quickly once the alarm sounds.
Each vault counts once; the 100% checklist needs 8 vault robberies, so this trophy's 5 are a milestone, not the end.
The silver pops after your fifth vault robbery and escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — ambush one, crack it open and lose the heat.
trophies.lastChance: Never — armored trucks run their routes at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route: they drive set roads around the city and the countryside.
Ambush the truck — block it, force it to stop and crack the rear doors open.
Grab the cash inside and get moving before the police response builds.
Lose the wanted level with a fast car and broken line of sight.
The trophy pops once you have robbed the truck and escaped.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk into every named area until the map is filled in.
trophies.lastChance: Never — exploration stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Leonida has 52 areas to explore, and each one counts when you first set foot or wheels inside it.
Drive through the map systematically, area by area, instead of fast-travelling past them.
Use a helicopter or plane for the far corners and islands that roads do not reach.
Check the map screen to see which areas are still greyed out and head for those.
The trophy pops when the 52nd area registers as explored.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida — hit one per gang.
trophies.lastChance: Never — gang operations stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, and each one runs illegal operations you can rob.
Find an operation on the map — look for gang territory markers and stash houses.
Hit the operation, grab the goods and get out before the gang's backup arrives.
Keep a list of which gangs you have already robbed so you do not hit the same gang twice.
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is unconfirmed — head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the view in front of you.
trophies.lastChance: Never — Ocean Beach stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: This is one of the unsolved hidden trophies: no guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so the method below is our best read of the description.
Go to Ocean Beach and find a beachfront bar or cocktail spot with a view over the water.
Order a cocktail there and stay by the view while you drink it.
If nothing pops, try different beachfront bars and different times of day — the trigger may be tied to a specific spot.
Flagged UNCONFIRMED in Vice Atlas until a guide confirms the exact spot.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger is unconfirmed — the obvious read is to drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front.
trophies.lastChance: Never — showrooms stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: This is one of the unsolved hidden trophies: no guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so the method below is our best read of the description.
Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front and a car you can drive inside.
Get in the car, build speed inside the showroom and smash straight out through the glass in classic style.
If nothing pops, try other showrooms — the trigger may be tied to one specific dealership.
Flagged UNCONFIRMED in Vice Atlas until a guide confirms the exact spot.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

dispute.a: PowerPyx reads this as stealing three valuables at the bowling alley — a theft, not a game of bowling [2].
dispute.b: No guide says you bowl a game here; the description's follow-through is read as the theft setup, and the method is not confirmed [7].
dispute.call: Our call: treat it as the bowling-alley theft until a guide confirms otherwise. Try stealing three valuables at the Kolt & Associates alley first; if that fails, bowl a full game there. Flagged UNCONFIRMED.

trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The guides disagree on what this means — see the dispute box for both versions.
trophies.lastChance: Never — the bowling alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in free roam.
Version A (PowerPyx): steal three valuables at the bowling alley — the description's follow-through is read as a theft, not a bowling game.
Version B: no guide says you bowl a game here, and the method is not confirmed — so if the theft does not trigger it, bowl a full game at the alley as the fallback.
Keep your wanted level low while you work: stealing in front of staff brings police fast.
The trophy pops when the correct trigger lands; flagged UNCONFIRMED until a guide confirms the method.

dispute.a: PowerPyx: reach max Strength on both characters — a body-stat grind for Jason and Lucia [2].
dispute.b: Push Square: reach max body fat instead — the opposite end of the same stat [3]. The method is not confirmed [7].
dispute.call: Our call: neither version is confirmed, so grind Strength first (PowerPyx's read), and if nothing pops, work toward max body fat. Flagged UNCONFIRMED.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The guides disagree on which body stat matters — see the dispute box for both versions.
trophies.lastChance: Never — body stats can be changed at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: This trophy is about a body stat shared across the partnership, but the guides disagree on which one.
Version A (PowerPyx): build max Strength on both characters — train, fight and work out until both hit the top of the stat.
Version B (Push Square): reach max body fat instead — eat and rest until the stat tops out.
Start with Strength, since that is the read most guides lead with, and check the stats screen after each session.
The method is not confirmed by any guide, so this trophy is flagged UNCONFIRMED until one version is proven.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. Choices are the small decisions the game offers as you play: dialogue picks, side-quest outcomes and story branches all feed the count.
trophies.lastChance: Never — choices keep coming in free roam and side content.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: PSN tracks this trophy to a count of 500 choices made across the game.
Make choices whenever the game offers them: dialogue options, who to help, how to finish a job — each one counts.
Play side content as well as the story, since stranger missions and activities offer plenty of choices.
The count builds up passively over a full playthrough, so do not grind it — just choose, every time.
The trophy pops when your 500th choice registers.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is unconfirmed — the natural read is to fail something once and succeed on the second try.
trophies.lastChance: Never — retries are always available in free roam.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: This is one of the unsolved hidden trophies: no guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so the method below is our best read of the description.
The description points at a second attempt: fail a mission, challenge or activity once, then succeed on the very next try.
Pick something repeatable — a race, a shooting challenge or a mission checkpoint — fail it once, then win it immediately after.
If nothing pops, the trigger may be tied to one specific event rather than any retry.
Flagged UNCONFIRMED in Vice Atlas until a guide confirms the exact trigger.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is unconfirmed — the natural read is to witness one of Leonida's strange random events.
trophies.lastChance: Never — random events keep happening in free roam.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: This is one of the unsolved hidden trophies: no guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so the method below is our best read of the description.
The description points at something strange: roam Leonida and watch for odd random events — UFOs, strange pedestrians, odd encounters.
Explore at night and in remote areas, where the game's weirdest events tend to spawn.
If nothing pops, the trigger may be one specific scripted event rather than any strange sighting.
Flagged UNCONFIRMED in Vice Atlas until a guide confirms the exact trigger.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The method is unconfirmed — the read is to knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.lastChance: Never — drive-bys can be done at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: The method for this trophy is unconfirmed: KeenGamer flags Ten Pin as unconfirmed, and no guide gives a proven method.
The description's read is a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock a pedestrian over.
Drive slowly through a crowded pavement, lean out and swing as you pass.
If nothing pops, try different melee weapons and different speeds — the trigger may need a specific setup.
Flagged UNCONFIRMED in Vice Atlas until a guide confirms the method.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — pass them to your contacts and the clean money counts.
trophies.lastChance: Never — laundering stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Marked Bills are the dirty cash from heists and robberies; they cannot be spent directly.
Take Marked Bills to your laundering contacts and convert them into clean money.
Each laundered batch counts toward the $250,000 total — keep robbing and laundering until the counter fills.
Bank jobs, vault robberies and armored trucks are the best sources of Marked Bills.
The trophy pops when your laundered total reaches $250,000.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop in Leonida counts — clothes, weapons, food, cars — so this fills up naturally if you buy what you need.
trophies.lastChance: Never — shops stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Every dollar spent in any shop counts toward the $100,000 total.
Buy weapons, ammo, armour, clothes and car upgrades as you play — the total builds up on its own.
Big purchases help most: a car or a high-end weapon moves the counter in one go.
Check the Stats screen to see how much of the $100,000 is done.
The trophy pops when your total spending reaches $100,000.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages store your vehicles, and each one needs to be bought, not just visited.
trophies.lastChance: Never — properties can be bought at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida.
Find each garage on the map — they are marked for sale — and buy it.
Garages cost money, so save up or launder Marked Bills first if you are short.
Each purchase counts once; check the property list to see which of the 8 are still unowned.
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is purchased.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app and register each one — ten different vehicles, not the same one ten times.
trophies.lastChance: Never — vehicles can be registered at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone to see the registration screen.
Find a vehicle, get in it and register it through the app — each distinct vehicle counts once.
Use ten different vehicles: cars, bikes and scooters all count if the app accepts them.
Check the app to see how many of the 10 are registered so far.
The trophy pops when the tenth vehicle is registered.
